persephone.name: Persephone
persephone.notes: Affordable alternative to Louis Vuitton's California Dream. Designed for hot climates.

concordia.name: Concordia
concordia.notes: Bright citrus-forward EDP. Inspired by LV Symphony. Clean, energizing sillage with 6-8 hr longevity.

amber-empire.name: Amber Empire
amber-empire.notes: Blonde Amber clone. Rich boozy oriental with vanilla-liqueur opening, ambery heart and warm woody-musk base.

leau-dissey-pour-homme-intense.name: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Intense
leau-dissey-pour-homme-intense.notes: Darker, warmer evolution of the classic 1994 original. Created by Jacques Cavallier (2007). Smoky incense dry-down. 6-7 hr longevity.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.notes: Creed Aventus Absolu alternative. Smooth, masculine, sophisticated chypre-leather. ~8 hr longevity.

blu-oud.name: Blu Oud
blu-oud.notes: Dark, sophisticated smoky-leathery scent despite the 'Blu' name. Bright citrus-green opening. 7-10 hr longevity.

royal-blend.name: Royal Blend
royal-blend.notes: Angels' Share clone. Boozy cognac-cinnamon-plum opening with warm myrrh-iris heart and creamy vanilla-sandalwood base.

supremacy-collectors-edition.name: Supremacy Collector's Edition
supremacy-collectors-edition.notes: 2024 release. Aventus DNA with fresh apple twist. 8-10 hr.

vulcan-feu.name: Vulcan Feu
vulcan-feu.notes: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim inspired. Tropical mango-rhubarb opening with floral-praline heart and warm woody base.

hawas-malibu.name: Hawas Malibu
hawas-malibu.notes: 2025 release. Light tropical opening, JPG Le Male DNA. 7-8 hr.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.notes: Dior Homme Intense/Parfum alternative. Creamy iris and leather. 8+ hr.

aquatica.name: Aquatica
aquatica.notes: Creed Virgin Island Water alt. Lime-coconut. Stronger than OG. 5-7 hr.

terra.name: Terra
terra.notes: Amouage Outlands alt. Bold resinous oriental. 8-10+ hr.

italia.name: Italia
italia.notes: Xerjoff XJ 1861 Naxos alt. Honey-tobacco aromatic.

tiger.name: Tiger
tiger.notes: Penhaligon's Halfeti alt. Rich woody-spicy. 6-8 hr.

elixir-rayhaan.name: Elixir
elixir-rayhaan.notes: Le Male Elixir profile. Minty opening, warm vanilla-tonka base. 2024.

royal-taboo.name: Royal Taboo
royal-taboo.notes: Initio Side Effect clone. Spicy cardamom-cinnamon opening with tobacco-heliotrope heart and warm vanilla-woody base.

x-xandal.name: X Xandal
x-xandal.notes: A triple-vanilla Extrait — Madagascar, Bourbon, and Vanilla Caviar top notes, with chocolate truffle, rum, and oud base. Heavy beast-mode gourmand.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.notes: LV Imagination-style freshie with minty twist. 6-10+ hr.

le-male-elixir.name: Le Male Elixir
le-male-elixir.notes: 2023 release by Quentin Bisch. Sweet creamy gourmand. 8-10 hr.

spectre-ghost.name: Spectre Ghost
spectre-ghost.notes: Nishane Ani clone. Spicy ginger-cardamom opening with floral blackcurrant-rose heart and smooth vanilla-cedar base.

janan-platinum.name: Janan Platinum
janan-platinum.notes: 2004 limited edition by J. (Junaid Jamshed). Discontinued.

marwa.name: Marwa
marwa.notes: LV Imagination alt. Aromatic citrus with ginger-cinnamon. 6-8 hr.

mazaaj-infused.name: Mazaaj Infused
mazaaj-infused.notes: 2016 release by Vincent Ricord. Fresh-sweet oriental woody. 7-8 hr.

liquid-brun.name: Liquid Brun
liquid-brun.notes: PDM Althair clone. Spicy cinnamon-orange blossom opening with creamy bourbon vanilla heart and ambroxan-woody base. Beast mode performer.

swy-intensely.name: Stronger With You Intensely
swy-intensely.notes: 2019 release. Iconic sweet gourmand. Vanilla-toffee-amber bomb. 8-10 hr.

hectic.name: Hectic
hectic.notes: 2024 release. Highly-regarded LV Imagination clone. Bright citrus opening with a black tea and ambroxan dry down.

reflection.name: Reflection
reflection.notes: LV Symphony inspired. Fresh aquatic-citrus with grapefruit-ginger opening and marine-cardamom heart.

opulence-leather.name: Opulence Leather
opulence-leather.notes: Formerly Amber & Leather. Spicy leather with floral undertones.

pure-skin.name: Pure Skin
pure-skin.notes: Inspired by Le Labo Another 13. Malaysian brand. Airy skin scent. 10+ hr.

harmonia.name: Harmonia
harmonia.notes: Inspired by LV Rain Tea. Floral-green tea scent with lemongrass, magnolia and woody base.

selene.name: Selene
selene.notes: Inspired by Louis Vuitton Moon Tale. Raspberry-magnolia floral musk.

nyx.name: Nyx
nyx.notes: Inspired by LV Ink Mark. Warm woody-incense with sandalwood, incense and amber at its core.

rare-reef.name: Rare Reef
rare-reef.notes: Refreshing citrus-marine with fruity-green heart. Fig-dates base. 8-10 hr.

pacific-aura.name: Pacific Aura
pacific-aura.notes: Fresh aquatic-tinged citrus aromatic. Minty-fig profile.

al-qiam-gold.name: Al Qiam Gold
al-qiam-gold.notes: LV Ombre Nomade alt. Leather-raspberry-oud. 8-10 hr.

tobacco-vanille.name: Tobacco Vanille
tobacco-vanille.notes: Tom Ford Private Blend. 2007. Iconic cold-weather staple. 10-12+ hr.

apple-brandy-on-the-rocks.name: Apple Brandy on the Rocks
apple-brandy-on-the-rocks.notes: By Kilian The Liquors collection. Apple-brandy boozy masterpiece. 8-10 hr.

interlude-man.name: Interlude Man
interlude-man.notes: Iconic Amouage. Oregano-incense-oud bomb. Legendary performance. 10-14 hr.

champion.name: Champion
champion.notes: A fresh aromatic-leather sporty fragrance with bright citrus opening and warm woody-musk drydown.

oud-mood.name: Oud Mood
oud-mood.notes: A warm sweet woody oriental centered around smooth non-animalic oud with creamy vanilla and spicy saffron.

zenith-deep.name: Zenith Deep
zenith-deep.notes: Bleu de Chanel clone. Fresh blue scent with zesty grapefruit-mint opening, spicy melon-ginger heart, and smoky woody base.

asad.name: Asad
asad.notes: Sauvage Elixir clone. Bold black pepper-pineapple opening with coffee-patchouli heart and warm amber-woody base.

asad-elixir.name: Asad Elixir
asad-elixir.notes: Sauvage Elixir flanker. Spicy pink pepper-saffron opening with tobacco-vanilla heart and smoky amber-frankincense base.

y-le-parfum-2025.name: Y Le Parfum 2025
y-le-parfum-2025.notes: 2025 reformulation by Dominique Ropion. Mature woody-aromatic with pine-balsam focus replacing the sweeter apple/tonka of the original.

oud-maracuja.name: Oud Maracujá
oud-maracuja.notes: A bold niche contrast of juicy passion fruit and smoky oud, created by Jordi Fernández. Stunning sweet-skanky duality.

khamrah-qahwa.name: Khamrah Qahwa
khamrah-qahwa.notes: Angels' Share inspired with coffee twist. Rich cinnamon-cardamom opening with praline-candied fruit heart and warm vanilla-coffee base.

jean-lowe-immortal.name: Jean Lowe Immortal
jean-lowe-immortal.notes: A fresh aromatic clone of Louis Vuitton L'Immensité with bright ginger-citrus opening and ambroxan-musk woody base.

oud-wood.name: Oud Wood
oud-wood.notes: A modern classic blending smooth agarwood with warm spices and creamy woods for a sophisticated versatile signature scent.

iii-thriller.name: III THRILLER
iii-thriller.notes: A bold Middle Eastern-inspired fragrance blending warm spices florals and a sweet vanilla-oud base that projects powerfully.

spicebomb.name: Spicebomb
spicebomb.notes: An explosion of hot spices wrapped in a fresh aromatic shell, drying down to warm tobacco-leather. Iconic 2012 release.

ameer-al-oudh-intense-oud.name: Ameer Al Oudh Intense Oud
ameer-al-oudh-intense-oud.notes: A massively projecting long-lasting fragrance combining smoky oud with sweet vanilla and warm spices offering incredible value.

ck-free.name: CK Free
ck-free.notes: A crisp modern aquatic-woody scent with a unique absinthe opening leading to a clean woody base.

california-blue.name: California Blue
california-blue.notes: Mykonos original. Fresh aquatic-fruity with lavender-grapefruit opening, marine-rhubarb heart, and caramel-woody base.

california-signature.name: California Signature
california-signature.notes: Mykonos original. Elegant citrus-aromatic with mandarin-lemon opening, complex herbal-aquatic heart, and woody-tonka base.

mayfair.name: Mayfair
mayfair.notes: Mykonos original. Polished luxury scent with bergamot-raspberry opening, caramel-floral heart, and leather-wood base.

bonfire-vanilla.name: Bonfire Vanilla
bonfire-vanilla.notes: By the Fireplace inspired. Rich sweet-spicy gourmand with clove-vanilla opening, smoky guaiac heart, and caramel-marshmallow base.

glitch.name: Glitch
glitch.notes: Complex fruity-fresh fragrance with Sicilian bergamot-apple opening and soft musky-vanilla base.

shiyaaka-shadow.name: Shiyaaka Shadow
shiyaaka-shadow.notes: A fresh aromatic fougère from Khadlaj Special Edition blending citrus top with herbal lavender-sage heart and woody-amber base.

hawas-black.name: Hawas Black
hawas-black.notes: A citrusy-fresh powerhouse often compared to Hacivat with bright bergamot-pineapple and dominant oakmoss-amber base.

hawas-chrome.name: Hawas Chrome
hawas-chrome.notes: A fresh citrus-aquatic flanker in the Hawas line with metallic-chrome edge and clean lavender-herbal heart over soft amber-musk base.

zeleny.name: Zeleny
zeleny.notes: A fruity-fresh green floral with woody-oriental dry-down balancing bright citrus and pine with warm leather-musk base.

corium.name: Corium
corium.notes: A bold gourmand-woody with roasted chestnut herbal lavender-sage heart and unique leather-oud-vanilla base.

lion-rayhaan.name: Lion
lion-rayhaan.notes: A fresh aromatic-sweet with pear-lavender opening warm cinnamon-spice heart and creamy vanilla-amber base.

wolf-rayhaan.name: Wolf
wolf-rayhaan.notes: A deceptively simple but rich gourmand built on cardamom-toffee-amberwood delivering warm sweet comfort.

oud-nacre.name: Oud Nacré
oud-nacre.notes: An exquisite Armani Privé creation combining rare oud with pearlescent rose and warm amber-vanilla for a sophisticated oriental signature.

orange-mediterranee.name: Orange Méditerranée
orange-mediterranee.notes: A bright Mediterranean citrus from Armani Privé Les Eaux with warm aromatic dry-down evoking sun-drenched orange groves.

myslf-labsolu.name: MYSLF L'Absolu
myslf-labsolu.notes: A richer more intense flanker of MYSLF amplifying the floral-woody accord with creamy vanilla and warm spices.

aether.name: Aether
aether.notes: PDM Greenley clone. Crisp green apple-citrus opening with woody-floral heart and mossy-amber base.

maahir-legacy.name: Maahir Legacy
maahir-legacy.notes: PDM Sedley clone. Fresh aromatic with lime-mint opening and spicy-herbal heart with woody-vetiver base.

obsidian-fa.name: Obsidian
obsidian-fa.notes: French Avenue original. An original creation, not a clone. Citrus-aldehydic opening with resinous myrrh-labdanum heart.

aurum.name: Aurum
aurum.notes: Reef Perfumes original. Tropical fruity-floral with pineapple-apple opening, jasmine-caramel heart and cedar-musk base.

uranus-velixir.name: Uranus
uranus-velixir.notes: LV Météore clone. Clean airy citrus-vetiver with spicy heart. 8+ hours. Created by Velixir Parfums.

poseidon-velixir.name: Poseidon
poseidon-velixir.notes: LV Afternoon Swim clone. Bright candied citrus with ginger-spicy warmth and salty ambergris drydown.

conquer.name: Conquer
conquer.notes: YSL MYSLF L'Absolu inspired. Bergamot-ginger-cardamom opening with orris-orange blossom heart. Great summer freshie.

sorrento.name: Sorrento
sorrento.notes: Italian coastal escape vibe. Fizzy grapefruit-magnolia blast with neroli and watery notes, drying to warm amber-musk.

naughty-dates.name: Naughty Dates
naughty-dates.notes: Dark potent gourmand built around sticky dates, coffee, and caramel. Floral fruity gourmand - your review is on TikTok.

golden-vanille.name: Golden Vanille
golden-vanille.notes: High Notes Timeless Collection. Warm luxurious gourmand with pink pepper, red apple opening and creamy vanilla-cashmere drydown.

lost-in-magnolia.name: Lost In Magnolia
lost-in-magnolia.notes: High Notes Timeless Collection. Earthy-magnolia floral with black tea and oakwood dry-down.

aqua-zyphra.name: Aqua Zyphra
aqua-zyphra.notes: A crisp aquatic-citrus freshie with herbal aromatic heart and clean musk-wood base for scorching days.

eros.name: Eros
eros.notes: The iconic Mediterranean powerhouse with minty-apple freshness and a seductive vanilla-tonka base.

icarus-velixir.name: Icarus
icarus-velixir.notes: LV Blue Talisman inspired. Juicy pear and bergamot open to a ginger-orange blossom heart with ambrox-cedar base.

aphrodite-velixir.name: Aphrodite
aphrodite-velixir.notes: LV La Vie Est Belle inspired. Bright lychee-ginger opening with floral peony-rose heart and earthy cacao-patchouli base.

roses-on-ice.name: Roses on Ice
roses-on-ice.notes: By Kilian The Liquors collection. Gin & tonic-inspired rose fragrance by Frank Voelkl. Icy aquatic cucumber-juniper opening with rose heart and musky-woody base.
